listenings.text: Hey, welcome back to the show. So today I'm gonna do something a little different. I've had a lotta messages from people asking how I got into fixing up old furniture, and honestly, it wasn't a plan. My grandfather left me a chair. That's it. That's the whole story. It was falling apart, and I kinda thought, well, I gotta do something with it. So I watched a couple of videos, I bought the wrong tools, I ruined it, and then I bought another chair and ruined that one too. What I wanna say to anybody starting out is this: you don't need a workshop and you don't need talent. You need a broken thing and about three weekends. Alright, that's enough from me. Let's get into today's episode.

Hey, it's me, sorry, I know it's early. Listen, I'm gonna be about twenty minutes late, because the vet called and they wanna keep the dog until eleven, which is, you know, kind of annoying, but whatever. So don't wait for me, just start without me, and I'll come straight over after. Oh, and I've got the paint. I got the wrong color, obviously, because I always do, but we can sorta work with it, I think. Anyway, gotta run, the other line is ringing. See you in a bit.

extra_audio.text: First, Rick says he is going to send the photos tonight. Then Ana says she lost him for a second and asks him to say it again more slowly. Next, Rick admits that he talks far too fast. After that, Ana explains that she only catches the gist and asks people to rephrase it. Finally, Ana asks Rick to say the fast version again.
